sut.name: sockshop
sut.deploy: kind cluster 'mist', ns sock-shop (July topology, istio-injected Java legs); javaagent 1.33.6 on orders/shipping/queue-master (768Mi limits). Leg = rabbitmq scale (control up / TP leg 0).

readback.locator: queue-master shipment record - NOT black-box observable: order.shipment is written at order creation regardless of enqueue success, and no read-back API reflects broker consumption. Discriminator is the AMQP-send trace span.

config.note: RabbitMQ made unavailable (scale rabbitmq to 0, or toxiproxy on the AMQP leg) while POST /orders executes. The fault-swallowing code path is UNMODIFIED SUT source: shipping's controller catches the enqueue failure and still returns success - source comment: 'Unable to add to queue... Accepting anyway. Don't do this for real!' (ShippingController). queue-master then never receives the shipping task.

stimulus.script: register -> login -> add cart item -> POST /orders (RabbitMQ down)

ground_truth.label: positive
ground_truth.rationale: Genuine masked failure, grounded in the unmodified SUT's source: the shipping service acknowledges the shipment request although the enqueue to RabbitMQ failed, and the source comment itself marks the swallow as an anti-pattern ('Don't do this for real!'). The order is 2xx-acked with a shipment object set at creation, while the shipping task is silently lost (queue-master persists nothing and never processes it). Unlike Bookinfo's ratings fallback there is no intended degraded UX communicated to the caller - the caller is told the shipment is accepted. Contestability note: a rater could argue 'demo code, author aware'; the code comment cuts the other way (the author flags it as wrong practice). Live adjudication may graduate this to stratum-3 if the label is contested.
ground_truth.doc_citation: microservices-demo/shipping ShippingController source comment ('Unable to add to queue... Accepting anyway. Don't do this for real!')

provenance.notes: Found by source inspection during the G3 prereg cold-review wave (research/REVIEW-PREREG-B-tech.md INFO-1); pre-registered in prep/g3-sut2-triples-prereg.md SS-C. This is the TRUE-POSITIVE twin of bookinfo-ratings-benign. REVIEW-CORPUS R4 (A-M3/C-F3) — the NAMED discriminator for the pair: sockshop is TRULY MASKED (the entry 2xx + shipment object is IDENTICAL to success; nothing communicates the loss) and the lost shipping task IS a REQUIRED durable downstream effect, whereas bookinfo's ratings is a contractually-OPTIONAL read whose degradation the entry response DOES communicate. naive_span_error and tracetest_presence flag BOTH cases (structural: error/absence under 2xx) = here TP, on bookinfo FP; the ONLY column that separates the pair is mist_trace_shape (flag here / no_flag on bookinfo) via that required-vs-optional-durable-effect semantics. PRECONDITION for the trace expectations: the two-part tracing mitigation from the G3 prereg (OTel Node auto-instrumentation on front-end + javaagents on orders/shipping) must be active AND the queue-master CONSUME span must be instrumented (so tracetest_presence can assert the absent consume span, and mist_trace_shape can see the missing required effect); else naive_span_error/tracetest_presence/mist_trace_shape are not_applicable as-deployed. mist_readback=not_applicable BY DESIGN and that is the honest point: no black-box read-back reflects broker consumption (order.shipment written at creation regardless), so this case documents the read-back oracle's applicability boundary - only the trace-shape/masking oracle sees this class. write_shape=partial-aggregate (order/parent lands, shipping task/child lost). rev-2 migration (2026-07-09): readback modality none-durable, expect pair (landed/not-landed) NOMINAL (R11: the shipping task is a real downstream effect but NOT black-box observable; the enum has no no-write value); mist_dataintegrity_oracle -> mist_readback_oracle=not_applicable; ADDED tracetest_presence_oracle=flag (missing enqueue/consume span). Status: SPECIFIED design-target (sockshop scaled to 0 -> not captured; these trace-column values are the intended-instrumented expectation per freeze R2, NOT a measured result). Natural positive by source inspection; stratum 1, may graduate to 3 on contested live capture. || TENANCY-WINDOW CAPTURE-OF-RECORD (2026-07-10, plan rev-2 unanimous-accept): captured on the live kind deploy — bookinfo via Envoy sidecar spans (mesh Telemetry 100% sampling, extensionProvider jaeger->collector:4317; reviews VS ASSERTED pinned to v3 pre-capture); sockshop via opentelemetry-javaagent 1.33.6 (sha 055c4fe4...) on orders/shipping/queue-master (hostPath+JTO, memory limit raised 500Mi->768Mi in the same patch — CLI -Xmx overrides JTO so heap untouched; DEFAULT instrumentation, no suppression). Frozen scorer defd9c9 extended PRE-CAPTURE with the pinned semantics (presence kind SERVER/CONSUMER; Envoy error rule http.status_code>=500; per-case naive scopes; entry-op fragments); names bound from control/canary traces only. Per-leg immediate Jaeger v2 exports; probe-first N>=4; fresh users per leg; complete new sidecars = capture-of-record. || MEASURED (this wave): rabbit scaled to 0; N>=4 consecutive 201-ack probes confirmed the 'Accepting anyway' swallow; the capture-of-record order acked 201 with the shipment object set and the order row PRESENT in the read-back list (the ORDER lands; the shipping task is what's lost — no API reflects broker consumption: the none-durable point stands). tracetest_presence=FLAG MEASURED (the queue-master 'shipping-task process' CONSUMER span is ABSENT from the 26-span fault trace; the 30-span control trace CONTAINS it = validated baseline, T1/B-B4). T2 DIVERGENCE (disclosed, dated 2026-07-10): the pre-registered naive_span_error=flag ('the AMQP-send failure span') was REFUTED by capture — with rabbitmq scaled to 0 the connection fails before Channel.basicPublish, no producer span is created, the swallow returns 2xx, and the fault trace carries ZERO error spans -> naive MEASURED no_flag = a FALSE NEGATIVE on the genuine leg. Combined with the control leg's queue-master docker-socket error span (see the control case), naive fails BOTH directions on this pair AND false-positives on clean operation — a stronger, fully measured indictment than the pre-registration. Recorded as measured; no selector/scope/rule was changed post-capture.
